sources.researchNote: The entry gives the theatre’s addresses: Nowy Świat 63 (5 September 1925 – 11 September 1926, hall of 1,000 seats), Marszałkowska 125 in the former Teatr Nowy (11 September 1926 – 28 August 1927) and Karowa 18 (30 August – 4 September 1927), and describes the dispute over the name that preceded the founding of Nowe Perskie Oko in November 1927 and of Morskie Oko.
